note.en: The one type definition: classes, properties, relations, controlled vocabularies and constraints. Data formats, SQL checks, prompts and site labels are generated from or checked against it. It holds no instances, no measurements and no dates.
note.zh-CN: 唯一的类型定义：类、属性、关系、受控词表、约束。数据文件格式、SQL 约束、提示词、站点标签都由它生成或与它核对。不含实例、不含测量结果、不含日期。

relationship_semantics.note: These are organization and association relations, not is_a inheritance. Shared labels do not merge editorial work and source tasks.

onet.description: O*NET 31.0 occupation, family, task and activity reference data; a United States occupational reference.
onet.export_note: O*NET 31.0 occupation, task and activity references. Chinese occupation labels are openaiwill AI adaptations, not official translations. This ontology export excludes weights, IM/RT ratings, frequency distributions, sample sizes and task counts; original source notes remain in platform 0.0.1.

isic.description: ISIC Revision 5 code hierarchy only; original descriptions are not redistributed.

editorial.description: The existing openaiwill editorial catalog; AI proposals remain drafts.
editorial.export_note: Existing AI-proposed market catalog and scope notes; associations remain candidates. This ontology export contains no weights, capability baseline or progress values.

limitations: O*NET is a United States reference; Chinese occupation labels are AI translations and task translations remain pending.
Definitions are null when no existing occupation description, task statement or editorial scope note is available.
AI-proposed mappings remain candidates and do not assert verified equivalence.
Weights, events, metrics, observations, progress and task statistics are outside this contract.

note.en: Records of how a fact was obtained. Defined by their tables only; not classes of this ontology.
note.zh-CN: 记录某个事实是怎么得到的。只由数据库表定义，不是本体的类。

definition.en: A sealed, identified entry of the world catalog: a market group, market, work, occupation group or occupation. The whole id is its identity.
definition.zh-CN: 世界目录里一个封存的、有标识的条目：赛道组、赛道、工作、职业大类或职业。整个 ID 就是它的身份。

definition.en: An editorial domain organizing related markets; not an industry weight or capability score.
definition.zh-CN: 归拢相关赛道的编辑领域；不是行业权重，也不是能力分数。

definition.en: An editorial market or service area grouping work that serves a related production or service need.
definition.zh-CN: 一个编辑赛道或服务领域，把服务于同一类生产或服务需求的工作归在一起。

definition.en: A named scope of work, either an editorial work item or a source occupation task; matching labels do not establish identity.
definition.zh-CN: 一项有名字的工作范围：编辑的工作条目，或来源职业的任务。名称相同不代表是同一项。

definition.en: An O*NET occupation family used to organize source occupations.
definition.zh-CN: 用来组织来源职业的 O*NET 职业大类。

definition.en: An O*NET occupation with its source identity and occupational description.
definition.zh-CN: 一个 O*NET 职业，带来源身份和职业描述。

definition.en: A non-capability condition that prevents autonomous completion even when every required capability is met.
definition.zh-CN: 即使所需能力全部达成，仍然阻止自主完成的条件。闸门不会因为模型变强而解除，需要制度、法规或物理条件改变。

definition.en: A company or institution we follow. Referred to by id everywhere (rule:org-must-be-id); the registry is datasets/semantic/organizations.json.
definition.zh-CN: 我们跟踪的公司或机构。任何地方都用 ID 引用（rule:org-must-be-id），名单在 datasets/semantic/organizations.json。

definition.en: A person whose public account we may collect, with the source of their identity.
definition.zh-CN: 我们可能采集其公开账号的一个人，带身份出处。

definition.en: A social account we collect from. It belongs to one person or one organization; a verified badge proves nothing about what it claims.
definition.zh-CN: 一个被采集的社交账号，属于一个人或一个机构。认证标记不证明它说的内容。

definition.en: A post's identity. Each collection run's snapshot of it is an observation, not another post.
definition.zh-CN: 一条帖子的身份。每次采集得到的快照是对它的一次观测，不是另一条帖子。

definition.en: One deduplicated update: something an organization released, changed, measured or announced. Several posts about the same thing are one update.
definition.zh-CN: 一条去重后的更新：某个机构发布、改动、测得或宣布的一件事。讲同一件事的多条帖子是一条更新。

observed_problem.zh-CN: 现行 dedup_key = slug(primary_org + title)。措辞不同即视为不同事件：Qwen3.8-Max-0902 tops CodeArena WebDev 被拆成 4 条，Apsara Conference 2026 被拆成 4 条，Tencent Agent Day 2 条。755 条里可确认的重复至少 10 条。

root_cause.zh-CN: 标题是自然语言，同一件事有无数种写法。用标题当身份，等于用措辞当身份。

rule.zh-CN: 事件身份由三元组决定：主体组织 ID + 事件类型 + 事件对象。事件对象指被发布/被评测/被采用的那个具体东西（产品版本、基准名、会议名），由模型显式抽取为 subject_key，而不是从标题里猜。同一三元组即同一事件，标题只作展示。

subject_key.zh-CN: 被讨论对象的规范名，小写、去空格与标点。产品用产品线+版本（wan-3.0），基准用基准名+赛道（codearena-webdev），活动用活动名+年份（apsara-conference-2026），事故用受影响服务+日期（grok-2026-09-18）。判不出对象时留空，此时退回标题 slug 并标记 identity_confidence 低。

occurrence_window.zh-CN: 同一三元组跨 14 天以上再次出现，视为新一次发生（例如年度会议），身份追加年份。

definition.en: A trained model, or a family of them, that its maker releases under a name: GPT-6 Astra, Claude Fable 5.1, Qwen3.8, Wan 2.7. A product, app, agent, feature, platform or service is not a model, even when it runs on one or shares its brand.
definition.zh-CN: 厂商以某个名字发布的一个训练好的模型，或一个模型系列：GPT-6 Astra、Claude Fable 5.1、Qwen3.8、Wan 2.7。产品、应用、智能体、功能、平台、服务都不是模型，即使它跑在模型上、或与模型同名。

definition.en: A platform through which a model is offered. The maker's own API is one; a cloud that serves several makers' models is another. A provider is not the model's owner.
definition.zh-CN: 提供模型访问的平台。厂商自己的 API 是一种，转售多家模型的云平台是另一种。供应商不是模型的归属方。

definition.en: One number, price, limit, score, date or scope a post states about an update, kept with the exact words it came from.
definition.zh-CN: 帖子就一条更新给出的一个数字、价格、限制、成绩、日期或适用范围，连同它出自的原文一起保存。

definition.en: A closed question about one job or one kind of business, with two to four answers that exclude each other. It stays open while claims and updates collect under it; it carries no answer of its own.
definition.zh-CN: 关于一个职业或一类生意的封闭问题，带两到四个互斥的答案。它一直开着，主张和更新不断归到它下面；它自己不带答案。

rule.en: One object and one kind of question make one topic. The wording of the question and its answers may be revised; the id does not change.
rule.zh-CN: 一个对象加一类问题就是一个话题。问题和答案的措辞可以修订，编号不变。

definition.en: One answer a reader can pick for a topic. It is a position somebody argued, or the direct opposite of one, written out so the question can be answered either way.
definition.zh-CN: 读者可以为一个话题选择的一个答案。它是某人主张过的立场，或其直接的反面，写出来是为了让问题两边都能选。

definition.en: The whole id is the identity; it is never rebuilt from a label or a path.
definition.zh-CN: 整个 ID 是身份，不根据名称或路径重新生成。

definition.en: Which concept class the entry is. Decides the type; never guessed from the id.
definition.zh-CN: 条目属于哪个概念类。类型由它决定，不从 ID 里猜。

definition.en: English name.
definition.zh-CN: 英文名。

definition.en: Simplified Chinese name.
definition.zh-CN: 简体中文名。

definition.en: Where the entry comes from.
definition.zh-CN: 条目的来源。

definition.en: State of the Chinese name.
definition.zh-CN: 中文名的状态。

definition.en: How far the entry's scope is defined.
definition.zh-CN: 条目范围定义到什么程度。

definition.en: An editorial note on scope.
definition.zh-CN: 编辑的范围说明。

definition.en: Definition text with its language and basis; null when no existing source text applies.
definition.zh-CN: 定义文本，带语言和依据；没有现成来源文本时为空。

definition.en: gate:<slug>. Stable.
definition.zh-CN: gate:<标识>。稳定。

definition.en: What kind of condition the gate is.
definition.zh-CN: 闸门是哪一类条件。

definition.en: English name.
definition.zh-CN: 英文名。

definition.en: Simplified Chinese name.
definition.zh-CN: 简体中文名。

definition.en: What must change for the gate to lift.
definition.zh-CN: 闸门解除需要改变什么。

definition.en: The same in Chinese.
definition.zh-CN: 同上，中文。

definition.en: Whether the gate is in use.
definition.zh-CN: 闸门是否在用。

definition.en: The gate that replaces a deprecated one.
definition.zh-CN: 接替已停用闸门的闸门。

definition.en: Why it was deprecated.
definition.zh-CN: 停用原因。

definition.en: org:<slug>. Every reference to an organization uses it.
definition.zh-CN: org:<标识>。凡是指向机构的地方都用它。

definition.en: English display name.
definition.zh-CN: 英文显示名。

definition.en: Chinese display name.
definition.zh-CN: 中文显示名。

definition.en: Other names that resolve to this organization.
definition.zh-CN: 解析到该机构的其他写法。

definition.en: person:<hash>. Stable.
definition.zh-CN: person:<哈希>。稳定。

definition.en: The name as the identity source writes it.
definition.zh-CN: 身份出处里的写法。

definition.en: Other spellings.
definition.zh-CN: 其他写法。

definition.en: Where the identity was established.
definition.zh-CN: 身份的出处。

definition.en: <platform>:<handle in lower case>.
definition.zh-CN: <平台>:<小写账号名>。

definition.en: The platform the account is on.
definition.zh-CN: 账号所在平台。

definition.en: The handle as written.
definition.zh-CN: 账号名原样。

definition.en: The platform's stable numeric id; null until resolved.
definition.zh-CN: 平台的稳定数字 ID；解析前为空。

definition.en: Whether a person or an organization owns it.
definition.zh-CN: 归属于个人还是机构。

definition.en: The role the account plays as a source.
definition.zh-CN: 账号作为来源的角色。

definition.en: Derived from the check log; never edited by hand.
definition.zh-CN: 由检查日志推导，不手工修改。

definition.en: How strongly the identity is established.
definition.zh-CN: 身份证据的强度。

definition.en: The identity evidence.
definition.zh-CN: 身份证据的出处。

definition.en: The profile image the platform returned for the account; null until a lookup has seen one. It shows who is speaking and proves nothing about identity.
definition.zh-CN: 平台返回的账号头像地址；账号查询见到之前为空。只用于显示是谁在说话，不证明身份。

definition.en: Posting language.
definition.zh-CN: 发帖语言。

definition.en: What the account mostly writes about.
definition.zh-CN: 账号主要写什么。

definition.en: Kept in the list but never collected.
definition.zh-CN: 留在名单里但不采集。

definition.en: The file the account was imported from.
definition.zh-CN: 账号从哪个文件导入。

definition.en: When panel_state last changed.
definition.zh-CN: panel_state 最近一次变化的时间。

definition.en: The platform's id of the post.
definition.zh-CN: 平台给帖子的 ID。

definition.en: The platform.
definition.zh-CN: 平台。

definition.en: The post's address.
definition.zh-CN: 帖子地址。

definition.en: The record kind; currently always a post.
definition.zh-CN: 记录类型；目前只有帖子。

definition.en: Original publication time, apart from when it was observed.
definition.zh-CN: 原始发布时间，与观测时间分开。

definition.en: Whether it replies to another post.
definition.zh-CN: 是否回复了另一条帖子。

definition.en: Whether it reposts another post.
definition.zh-CN: 是否转发了另一条帖子。

definition.en: The thread it belongs to.
definition.zh-CN: 所属会话。

definition.en: Stable id of the update.
definition.zh-CN: 更新的稳定 ID。

definition.en: What kind of update it is.
definition.zh-CN: 更新的类型。

definition.en: Which version of the kind vocabulary the row was classified under.
definition.zh-CN: 该行是按哪个版本的类型词表分类的。

definition.en: The canonical name of the thing the update is about; part of its identity.
definition.zh-CN: 更新对象的规范名，是同一性的一部分。

definition.en: A display title.
definition.zh-CN: 显示用标题。

definition.en: What happened, from the source text only.
definition.zh-CN: 发生了什么，只依据来源文本。

definition.en: When it was announced.
definition.zh-CN: 宣布时间。

definition.en: When it happened.
definition.zh-CN: 发生时间。

definition.en: When it is due to happen.
definition.zh-CN: 预定发生时间。

definition.en: Whether it has happened.
definition.zh-CN: 是否已发生。

definition.en: The extractor's confidence, 0 to 1.
definition.zh-CN: 抽取的置信度，0 到 1。

definition.en: How surely the subject was identified.
definition.zh-CN: 对象识别的把握。

definition.en: model:<owner>:<slug of the name>. Stable; never reused.
definition.zh-CN: model:<归属方>:<名字的规范写法>。稳定，不复用。

definition.en: The company that makes the model, when it is one we follow.
definition.zh-CN: 出品公司，限我们跟踪的公司。

definition.en: The maker as the post writes it, for a maker outside the registry.
definition.zh-CN: 出品方不在名单内时，帖子里的原样写法。

definition.en: Family or release.
definition.zh-CN: 系列还是具体版本。

definition.en: The family a release belongs to. A family has none.
definition.zh-CN: 具体版本所属的系列。系列自身没有。

definition.en: The release name as its maker writes it, without a date or build suffix.
definition.zh-CN: 厂商的写法，不带日期或构建号后缀。

definition.en: The version as written. Never inferred; a family has none.
definition.zh-CN: 文本里写出的版本号。不推断；系列没有。

definition.en: The variant (Flash, Pro, mini). A family has none.
definition.zh-CN: 变体（Flash、Pro、mini）。系列没有。

definition.en: How far the model's existence is established.
definition.zh-CN: 模型的存在被确认到什么程度。

definition.en: When the maker's own release update happened. Set only by confirmation.
definition.zh-CN: 厂商自己的发布帖的时间。只在确认时写入。

definition.en: The update whose mention opened this model. Null for a model known only from the catalog.
definition.zh-CN: 最早提到它并开出这一行的事件。只来自目录的模型为空。

definition.en: The catalog's canonical id, <owner>/<model>. Null when the catalog does not list it.
definition.zh-CN: 目录里的规范标识，<归属方>/<模型>。目录未收录则为空。

definition.en: The earliest date any provider lists the model in the catalog. A listing date, kept apart from released_at.
definition.zh-CN: 目录里任一供应商最早的上架日期。是上架日期，与 released_at 分开存。

definition.en: Whether the weights are published. Null when the catalog does not say or its listings disagree.
definition.zh-CN: 权重是否公开。目录没说或各条目不一致时为空。

definition.en: What the model produces. Empty when the catalog does not say or its listings disagree.
definition.zh-CN: 模型产出什么。目录没说或各条目不一致时为空。

definition.en: provider:<catalog key>.
definition.zh-CN: provider:<目录里的键>。

definition.en: Display name.
definition.zh-CN: 显示名。

definition.en: The maker's own API or a platform serving several makers.
definition.zh-CN: 厂商自己的 API，还是提供多家模型的平台。

definition.en: The account whose owner did what the update describes. Filled by the program from the source post, never by the model.
definition.zh-CN: 做了这件事的一方所对应的来源账号。由程序从来源帖子得到，不由模型填写。

definition.en: The product or model the update is about, as the post names it.
definition.zh-CN: 更新所涉及的产品或模型，按帖子里的写法原样记录。

definition.en: On what basis the update is known, judged by who produced the evidence in the source post.
definition.zh-CN: 这条更新凭什么成立，按来源帖子里的证据由谁产生来判断。

definition.en: One plain sentence saying what concrete piece of work the AI was given. Only for usage reports, independent evaluations, failure reports and production adoption.
definition.zh-CN: 一句话说明让 AI 做了哪件具体的事。只用于使用实录、独立测评、失败报告和生产采用。

definition.en: How the task came out. Only for the kinds that carry a task.
definition.zh-CN: 这件事的结果。只用于带有 task 的类型。

definition.en: The exact sentence of the source post that states the update.
definition.zh-CN: 来源帖子里陈述这条更新的原句。

definition.en: The schema version the update was extracted under. Empty means it was extracted before 2.2.0.
definition.zh-CN: 这条更新按哪一版 schema 提取。为空表示早于 2.2.0。

definition.en: Identifier of the fact.
definition.zh-CN: 事实的标识。

definition.en: The update the fact belongs to.
definition.zh-CN: 事实所属的更新。

definition.en: The post the fact was read from.
definition.zh-CN: 事实出自的帖子。

definition.en: The value as the post gives it.
definition.zh-CN: 帖子给出的值。

definition.en: The unit of the value, when it has one.
definition.zh-CN: 值的单位，没有则为空。

definition.en: What the value measures.
definition.zh-CN: 这个值指的是什么。

definition.en: The exact words of the post the value comes from; checked against the post text before it is stored.
definition.zh-CN: 值所出自的帖子原文；入库前与帖子正文核对。

definition.en: Stable id of the topic.
definition.zh-CN: 话题的固定编号。

definition.en: Which kind of question it is.
definition.zh-CN: 它是哪一类问题。

definition.en: The job or kind of business the question is about, in a normalized form; with the question type it is the topic's identity.
definition.zh-CN: 问题所谈的职业或生意的规范化写法；与问题类型一起构成话题的身份。

definition.en: The question in English.
definition.zh-CN: 问题的英文。

definition.en: The question in Simplified Chinese.
definition.zh-CN: 问题的简体中文。

definition.en: Where the topic stands as a subject of research.
definition.zh-CN: 话题作为研究对象所处的状态。

definition.en: How the topic came to be proposed.
definition.zh-CN: 话题是怎么被提出的。

definition.en: When the topic was opened: the time of the post that first raised it, or of the proposal.
definition.zh-CN: 话题提出的时间：最早提出它的帖子的发布时间，或提议的时间。

definition.en: When state last changed.
definition.zh-CN: state 最近一次变化的时间。

definition.en: The ontology version the topic was written under.
definition.zh-CN: 话题写入时的本体版本。

definition.en: Stable id of the answer.
definition.zh-CN: 选项的固定编号。

definition.en: The topic the answer belongs to.
definition.zh-CN: 选项所属的话题。

definition.en: Its place among the topic's answers.
definition.zh-CN: 它在话题各选项中的顺序。

definition.en: The answer in English.
definition.zh-CN: 选项的英文。

definition.en: The answer in Simplified Chinese.
definition.zh-CN: 选项的简体中文。

definition.en: No longer offered. An answer somebody argued or voted for is retired, never deleted.
definition.zh-CN: 不再提供。有人主张过或投过票的选项只停用，不删除。

definition.en: Organizes a market within an editorial domain.
definition.zh-CN: 把一个赛道归入一个编辑领域。

definition.en: Associates a work item with a market.
definition.zh-CN: 把一项工作关联到一个赛道。

definition.en: Organizes an occupation within an occupation family.
definition.zh-CN: 把一个职业归入一个职业大类。

definition.en: Associates work with an occupation; source task membership is retained.
definition.zh-CN: 把工作关联到一个职业；保留来源任务的归属。

definition.en: The concept corresponds to a record of an external source system.
definition.zh-CN: 该概念对应外部来源系统里的一条记录。

definition.en: A market's work item is carried out through this occupation task.
definition.zh-CN: 赛道里的这项工作通过这条职业任务来完成。

definition.en: The work stays limited by this gate however capable the model is.
definition.zh-CN: 即使所需能力齐备，这项工作仍受此闸门限制。必须指出依据的任务原文（because_task_id），不能只写理由文字。

definition.en: People in this occupation do the market's work.
definition.zh-CN: 该职业的人做这个赛道的工作。

definition.en: The update is evidence about how far this work can be done, at a level capped by its tier.
definition.zh-CN: 这条更新是关于该项工作能做到什么程度的证据，级别受证据等级封顶。

definition.en: A panel post bears on a vendor's claim about a piece of work.
definition.zh-CN: 名单账号的一条帖子对厂商关于某项工作的说法构成验证材料。

definition.en: The post belongs to the update through a reply, quote or repost chain, or by naming its product.
definition.zh-CN: 帖子沿回复、引用、转发链，或因提到产品名，归属到这条更新。

definition.en: The update was extracted from this post.
definition.zh-CN: 这条更新是从该帖子抽取的。

definition.en: The organization the update is about.
definition.zh-CN: 更新的主体机构。

definition.en: The update names this model, in a stated role.
definition.zh-CN: 这条更新提到了这个模型，并说明它在更新里的角色。判官只抄出名字和角色，由确定性的别名表决定是哪个模型。

definition.en: The organization trains and releases the model.
definition.zh-CN: 这家公司训练并发布了这个模型。归属看目录规范标识里的归属方或帖子写明的出品方，不看是谁在卖（rule:model-owner-is-not-provider）。

definition.en: A family contains a release. Only a family can be the parent.
definition.zh-CN: 系列包含具体版本。只有系列能做上游，系列自身没有上游。

definition.en: The provider lists the model from a given day. From the catalog, not a maker's statement.
definition.zh-CN: 这个供应商从某一天起提供这个模型。来自目录，不是厂商声明。

definition.en: The organization that runs the provider, when it is one we follow.
definition.zh-CN: 运营该供应商的机构，限我们跟踪的机构。

definition.en: The person or organization the account belongs to.
definition.zh-CN: 账号属于哪个人或机构。

definition.en: A dated relation between a person and an organization, with its source.
definition.zh-CN: 人物与机构之间带起止时间和出处的关系。

definition.en: The account that published the post.
definition.zh-CN: 发布该帖子的账号。

definition.en: The post it replies to.
definition.zh-CN: 它回复的帖子。

definition.en: The post it quotes.
definition.zh-CN: 它引用的帖子。

definition.en: The post it reposts.
definition.zh-CN: 它转发的帖子。

definition.en: The account whose owner did what the update describes.
definition.zh-CN: 做了这件事的一方所对应的来源账号。

definition.en: The post is about an update that already exists: it repeats it, adds to it, or reports a use or test of it. It records that the account said so, not that the account is right. Decided by reading the post, not by its reply or quote chain.
definition.zh-CN: 帖子在说一条已存在的更新：复述它、补充它，或报告对它的使用或测试。它记录的是这个账号这么说了，不是说得对。由读帖子内容确定，不靠回复或引用链。

definition.en: The catalog entry that is the thing the question is about, or clearly contains it. Empty when the catalog has no such entry; a near neighbour is not used instead.
definition.zh-CN: 目录里就是问题所谈对象、或明确包含它的那个条目。目录里没有时为空，不拿相近的条目代替。

definition.en: The answers a reader can pick for the topic: two to four that are not retired.
definition.zh-CN: 读者可以为话题选择的答案：未停用的有两到四个。

definition.en: The post's author asserts this answer to the topic's question. It records that the account said so, not that the account is right. A post argues at most one answer of a topic.
definition.zh-CN: 帖子作者对话题的问题主张这个答案。它记录的是这个账号这么说了，不是说得对。一条帖子对一个话题最多主张一个答案。

definition.en: The topic was found to ask the same question as another and now stands under it. It keeps its id.
definition.zh-CN: 该话题被认定与另一个话题问的是同一个问题，现归于其下。它保留自己的编号。

definition.en: A market measurement is about this market or occupation. It says how much the market uses, pays or employs; it is never evidence of how far a piece of work can be done.
definition.zh-CN: 一条市场测量说的是这个市场或职业。它说明这个市场有多少在使用、付费或雇用；它不是某项工作能做到什么程度的证据。

definition.en: The update is evidence for or against this answer to the topic's question: a measured result, a real deployment, a use or a failure that makes the answer more likely, or less likely, to be true. Read by a judge, one answer at a time; it says which way the update weighs, not that the answer is right or wrong.
definition.zh-CN: 这条更新是话题问题的这个答案的正面或反面证据：一个测得的结果、一次真实部署、一次使用或一次失败，使这个答案更可能、或更不可能成立。由判官逐个答案判断；它说明更新偏向哪一边，不说明这个答案是对还是错。

definition.en: A product, model or service that did not previously exist publicly is announced for the first time.
definition.zh-CN: 一个此前不存在公开版本的产品、模型或服务首次对外公布。

discriminator.zh-CN: 与 version_release 的分界：该产品线此前有无任何公开版本。有，就是 version_release；没有，才是 product_launch。名称中带版本号/代际（3.0、v2、-0902）几乎总是 version_release。

product_launch.negative_example: Alibaba releases Wan3.0 —— 属 version_release，Wan 系列此前已有公开版本

definition.en: A new version of an existing product line is released.
definition.zh-CN: 已有产品线发布新版本。

discriminator.zh-CN: 出现版本号、代际或日期戳（Wan3.0、GPT-Live-1、Qwen3.8-Max-0902），且该产品线此前已公开。与 capability_update 的分界：有版本标识是 version_release，只是功能增减无版本标识是 capability_update。

version_release.negative_example: Gemini app adds file upload —— 无版本标识，属 capability_update

definition.en: Who can use an already-released product, or where, changes: regions, platforms, eligibility, waitlist, preview-to-GA.
definition.zh-CN: 已发布产品的可获得范围改变：地区、平台、资格、等待名单、预览转正式。

discriminator.zh-CN: 产品本身没变，变的是「谁能用 / 在哪能用 / 是否还要排队」。判别关键词：generally available、rolls out to、now in、expands to、waitlist removed。若同一条消息既是首发又立即全量可用，归 product_launch，不重复计。

availability_change.positive_example: Wan3.0 generally available in Singapore region
availability_change.negative_example: Wan3.0 launches across platforms —— 若该产品此前未公开，归 product_launch

definition.en: An existing product gains, improves or removes a function without a new version identifier.
definition.zh-CN: 已有产品新增、改进或移除功能，但未标注新版本。

discriminator.zh-CN: 无版本标识，描述的是功能本身的增减。与 version_release 的分界只看有无版本标识。

capability_update.positive_example: ChatGPT Projects now supports scheduled runs
capability_update.negative_example: GPT-Live-1 released —— 有版本标识，属 version_release

definition.en: Price, quota, free tier or billing model changes.
definition.zh-CN: 价格、配额、免费额度或计费方式变更。

discriminator.zh-CN: 必须出现具体的价格、配额或计费方式。「更划算」「性价比更高」这类形容不算，除非给出数字。

pricing_change.positive_example: Gemini API cuts input token price by 50%
pricing_change.negative_example: New tier offers better value —— 无具体数字，不计

definition.en: A reproducible quantitative test result with a named benchmark and a number or rank.
definition.zh-CN: 具名基准上的可复现量化结果，带数值或排名。

discriminator.zh-CN: 必须有具名基准（CodeArena、Artificial Analysis、Pipecat、MMLU）且结果原则上可被第三方复算。与 third_party_recognition 的分界：基准可复算，机构评级不可复算。Gartner Magic Quadrant、IDC MarketScape、Forrester Wave 一律不是基准。

benchmark_result.negative_example: Named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant —— 属 third_party_recognition
benchmark_result.typical_tier: T1 若由第三方运行；T3 若厂商自测自报

definition.en: A rating, quadrant placement, ranking or award issued by an outside institution, not based on a reproducible quantitative test.
definition.zh-CN: 由外部机构给出的评级、象限、榜单或奖项，不基于可复现的量化测试。

discriminator.zh-CN: 来源是分析机构、媒体或评审委员会，结论依赖机构判断。与 benchmark_result 的分界：能否被第三方按公开方法复算。

third_party_recognition.positive_example: Recognized as a Leader in IDC MarketScape for AI platforms
third_party_recognition.negative_example: Ranks first on Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index —— 属 benchmark_result

definition.en: A named adopting organization reports the technology running in its real business operations.
definition.zh-CN: 具名采用方报告该技术已在其真实业务中运行。

discriminator.zh-CN: 必须同时满足三点：(1) 采用方是厂商以外的具名主体；(2) 描述的是已在运行，不是试用、试点计划或意向；(3) 有可指认的业务场景。厂商说「已被数千家企业使用」不算——没有具名主体。这是自主阶段 3/4 唯一的硬证据类型，宁可漏判也不要放宽。

production_adoption.positive_example: Klarna says its AI assistant now handles two-thirds of customer service chats
production_adoption.negative_example: Trusted by thousands of enterprises —— 无具名主体，不计
production_adoption.typical_tier: T1 若采用方自述；T3 若厂商代述

definition.en: Two or more organizations announce a cooperation, integration or commercial agreement.
definition.zh-CN: 两个及以上组织宣布合作、集成或商业协议。

discriminator.zh-CN: 与 production_adoption 的分界：合作是关系的建立，生产采用是已在运行的使用。「X 与 Y 达成合作」是 partnership；「Y 已用 X 处理其全部工单」是 production_adoption。

partnership.positive_example: Anthropic and Deloitte announce enterprise deployment partnership
partnership.negative_example: Deloitte now runs 40% of audits on Claude —— 属 production_adoption

definition.en: A paper, technical report or method disclosure not tied to a shippable product.
definition.zh-CN: 论文、技术报告或方法披露，不直接对应可用产品。

discriminator.zh-CN: 与 version_release 的分界：读者今天能不能用上。能用是发布，不能用是研究。

research_result.positive_example: DeepMind publishes paper on long-horizon agent planning
research_result.negative_example: DeepMind ships the planner in Gemini —— 属 capability_update

definition.en: A product, model or interface is retired or given a retirement schedule.
definition.zh-CN: 产品、模型或接口停止提供，或公布退役时间表。

discriminator.zh-CN: 包含「将于 X 日停止」这类有时间表的预告，不必已经下线。与 availability_change 的分界：可获得范围缩小但仍提供是 availability_change，彻底终止才是 deprecation。

deprecation.negative_example: Model no longer available in the EU —— 属 availability_change

definition.en: A person joins, leaves or changes role at an organization.
definition.zh-CN: 人员加入、离开或职务变更。

discriminator.zh-CN: 只记组织与人的关系变化本身。若消息重点是此人宣布的产品，归该产品对应的类型。

personnel.positive_example: Meta appoints new head of superintelligence research
personnel.negative_example: New CTO announces the 3.0 roadmap —— 重点是路线图，按产品类型判

definition.en: A conference, livestream, contest, hackathon or community gathering is announced, scheduled or held.
definition.zh-CN: 会议、直播、比赛、黑客松或社区活动的公布、排期或举办。

discriminator.zh-CN: 活动本身是主体。若消息重点是活动上发布的产品，归该产品对应的类型，不归此类。同一场活动的多条消息必须合并为一个事件（见去重规则）。

event_announcement.negative_example: At Apsara, Alibaba releases Wan3.0 —— 重点是发布，属 version_release

retired_because.en: A conference, contest or workshop is neither something an AI product can now do nor someone's account of using one. Rows written under 2.0.0 keep the term.
retired_because.zh-CN: 会议、比赛或研讨会既不是 AI 产品现在能做的事，也不是某人使用它的陈述。2.0.0 下写入的行保留这个词条。

definition.en: A service outage, failure, degradation or security incident, and its resolution.
definition.zh-CN: 服务中断、故障、降级或安全事件，及其恢复。

definition_why.zh-CN: 可靠性是自主阶段 3/4 的必要条件。事故是能力的反向证据：一个还在频繁中断的服务，不可能被判为自主生产。缺这个类目，负面证据无处可放，进度只会被高估。

discriminator.zh-CN: 包括恢复通告——恢复通告同时确认了事故的存在。与 policy_statement 的分界：事故是发生了什么，立场声明是打算怎么做。

incident.positive_example: Grok outage at Memphis compute center restored
incident.negative_example: We are publishing our incident disclosure policy —— 属 policy_statement

definition.en: An organization states a position or publishes rules on governance, safety, disclosure or acceptable use.
definition.zh-CN: 组织就治理、安全、披露或使用规则表明立场或发布规范。

definition_why.zh-CN: 影响的是闸门（gate），不是能力状态。制度变化会解除闸门，模型变强不会。

discriminator.zh-CN: 与 incident 的分界：立场声明是规则与打算，事故是已发生的事实。

policy_statement.positive_example: OpenAI publishes stance on misalignment incident disclosure
policy_statement.negative_example: Model misalignment caused a production outage —— 属 incident

definition.en: A named person or organization describes using an AI product to carry out a concrete piece of work, and says what came out.
definition.zh-CN: 具名的人或机构讲述用 AI 产品完成了一件具体的事，并说明结果。

discriminator.zh-CN: 必须有一件具体的事：AI 被交给了什么工作。「用了一整天」「感觉更好」「我更喜欢 X」是观点，不计。与 production_adoption 的分界：生产采用是机构的日常业务在运行，使用实录是某一次具体的使用。用 AI 产品做出自己的工具，属此类，不是 capability_update。

usage_report.positive_example: I had the agent list my old GPUs on eBay, research prices and track the sales
usage_report.negative_example: Used it all day, it feels better —— 没有具体的事，属观点，不计

definition.en: Someone other than the maker tests or measures an AI product and reports what they found.
definition.zh-CN: 出品方以外的人测试或测量 AI 产品，并报告结果。

discriminator.zh-CN: 测的人不是出品方。与 benchmark_result 的分界：具名基准上的成绩归 benchmark_result；自己设计的测试、对比或测速归此类。必须说明测了什么。

independent_evaluation.positive_example: Ran the model locally on an M3 Ultra and measured about 75 tokens per second
independent_evaluation.negative_example: The vendor says it is twice as fast —— 出品方自述，不是独立测评

definition.en: Someone reports an AI product failing at, or being unable to do, a concrete piece of work.
definition.zh-CN: 有人报告 AI 产品在一件具体的事上失败或做不到。

discriminator.zh-CN: 必须有一件具体的事和失败的表现。与 incident 的分界：事故是服务本身中断或故障；失败报告是服务正常但把事情做错了或做不成。泛泛的不满不计。

failure_report.positive_example: Asked it to migrate the database schema and it dropped a production table
failure_report.negative_example: This model is overhyped —— 没有具体的事，不计

definition.en: A third party publishes its own measurement of how AI is taken up or what it does to work: how many people or companies use or pay for AI, what they spend on it, how AI products rank by use, or what happened to employment or hiring in a named occupation or industry as AI spread.
definition.zh-CN: 第三方发布自己对 AI 被采用的程度或它对工作的影响的测量：多少人或公司在使用 AI、为它付费，在它上面花了多少，AI 产品按使用量的排名，或在 AI 扩散的过程中某个具名职业或行业的就业、招聘发生了什么。

discriminator.zh-CN: 量的必须是 AI 的采用、花费、排名，或与 AI 相关的某个具名职业、行业的就业和招聘；与 AI 无关的统计（总体就业、股价、宗教、选举）不属此类，丢弃。对象是一个市场或一个职业，不是某一个产品的功能。必须给出至少一个数字和它量的是什么。与 research_result 的分界：研究成果是方法或论文本身，这里是对现实的一次量化读数。与 benchmark_result、independent_evaluation 的分界：那两类量的是模型做题或做事的表现，这里量的是采用、花费、排名或就业。没有数字的市场看法是观点，丢弃。

market_measurement.positive_example: 98% of US households aren't paying for AI yet, from our State of Markets report
market_measurement.negative_example: We think consumer AI is still early —— 没有数字，是观点；Payroll employment rose 29,000 in September —— 与 AI 无关的总体统计

no_other_bucket.zh-CN: 取消 other。判不出来时返回 null 并记 unresolved_reason，让它可被统计和改进；other 会把问题藏起来——现在藏了 23%。

unresolved.zh-CN: 判不出类型时 kind 置 null，并必须写 unresolved_reason 说明卡在哪。unresolved_reason 是自由文本但不得为空。

label.zh-CN: 第三方基准或他方生产采用
label.en: Third-party result or others' production use

definition.zh-CN: 由与发布方无隶属关系的一方给出的可核验结果，或采用方自己确认的生产使用。当发布方本身就是采用方（不是厂商）时，以本层为准而不是 T3——采用方说自己在用，与厂商说自己的产品好，是两种不同的陈述。
definition.en: A checkable result produced by a party with no affiliation to the publisher, or an adopting organisation confirming its own production use. When the publisher IS the adopter rather than the vendor, this tier applies rather than T3: an adopter saying it depends on something is a different statement from a vendor saying its product is good.

definition.zh-CN: 两个及以上互相独立的来源分别描述同一事实。同集团的两个账号不算两方，同一全文被不同账号转述也不算。
definition.en: Two or more mutually independent sources describe the same fact. Two accounts of the same group are not two parties, and the same text restated by different accounts is not corroboration.

definition.zh-CN: 发布方自己的官方声明、文档或数据。指厂商谈自己的产品；若发布方是采用方在谈自己的使用，属 T1。
definition.en: The publisher's own statement, documentation or self-reported numbers. This means a vendor talking about its own product; a publisher describing its own USE of someone else's product is T1.

definition.zh-CN: 无法追溯到具体主体或无法复核的陈述。
definition.en: A statement that cannot be traced to a responsible party or re-checked.

stage_cap.zh-CN: 上一代能力层的 0-4 刻度上限，随 autonomy_stage 一起退役。

level_cap.zh-CN: 活动层级 0-5 刻度上限。一条活动证据能支持到的最高层级，由它的证据层级决定。

definition.en: AI takes no part in this work.
definition.zh-CN: AI 不参与这项工作。

label.en: AI helps, a person does it

definition.en: AI helps in places; a person does the whole delivery.
definition.zh-CN: AI 在局部帮忙，交付整体由人完成。

label.en: AI drafts, a person fixes each

definition.en: AI produces the bulk; a person reviews and corrects every item.
definition.zh-CN: AI 产出主体内容，人逐件复核并修正。

definition.en: AI completes it; a person spot-checks rather than reviews each one.
definition.zh-CN: AI 独立做完，人抽查而不是逐件复核。

label.en: No person, within a set scope

definition.en: AI delivers alone inside a defined scope, running in real business.
definition.zh-CN: AI 在限定范围内独立交付，且已在真实业务中运行。

definition.en: AI delivers alone in any setting, with no defined scope limiting it.
definition.zh-CN: AI 在任何场景下独立交付，没有限定范围兜底。

top_rung_is_permanent.zh-CN: 5 不因为当前没有证据就从刻度上撤掉。空的最高档是一个发现，不是一个缺口。

definition.zh-CN: AI 不参与这项工作。
definition.en: AI takes no part in this work.

definition.zh-CN: AI 提供片段性帮助，人完成全部交付。
definition.en: AI helps in pieces; a person produces the whole deliverable.

definition.zh-CN: AI 产出主要内容，人逐项审查并修正。
definition.en: AI produces the substance; a person reviews and corrects every item.

definition.zh-CN: AI 独立完成，人抽检；限定范围内已在真实业务中运行。
definition.en: AI completes the work independently and a person spot-checks; running in real operations within a bounded scope.

definition.zh-CN: AI 独立完成并交付，人只提目标与验收。
definition.en: AI completes and delivers independently; a person only sets the goal and accepts the result.

adoption_stage.zh-CN: adoption_stage 是证据属性（某个采用方走到哪一步），autonomy_stage 是能力结论（这项工作 AI 能独立到哪一步）。两者不互换，adoption_stage 只作为证据层级的输入之一。

label.en: Role of a person in an event

definition.en: Speaking for the publishing organisation.
Speaking on the organisation's behalf.
Reporting their own work at the publishing organisation.
Testing something they did not build.
Reporting how their own organisation uses it.
An account that cannot be traced to a responsible party.

label.en: Role of a person in an organization

definition.en: Holds decision authority in the organisation.
Sits on the governing body.
Does research at the organisation.
Builds or operates the organisation's systems.
Speaks publicly for the organisation.
The role is not established. Not a claim that there is none.

definition.zh-CN: 法律或行业规章要求。
definition.en: A law or regulation requires it be done a particular way, or by a particular kind of party.

definition.zh-CN: 出错时须由可追责的人或机构承担。
definition.en: Someone must be answerable for the outcome, so an organisation assigns an accountable person.

definition.zh-CN: 须由具备资格的人签字、批准或确认。
definition.en: A person holding a specific authorisation must decide or sign.

definition.zh-CN: 须在现场进行物理操作。
definition.en: The work requires being somewhere and acting on the physical world.

definition.zh-CN: 所需数据不可得或不可用。
definition.en: The information needed is not available to an automated system.

definition.zh-CN: 直接来自外部来源的结构，不含本项目判断。
definition.en: The relation comes from the source data's own structure.

definition.zh-CN: 由模型提出，未经人工确认。
definition.en: A model proposed it. It stays a candidate until a person confirms it.

definition.zh-CN: 经人逐条确认。
definition.en: A named person confirmed it, at a recorded time.
Carried over from the source; not a judgement of ours.
Proposed and not yet reviewed. Must not enter a calculation.
Confirmed by a person.
A person declined it. Kept so it is not proposed again as if unseen.
In use.
Retired. Must name a replacement or say why it is obsolete; its id is never reused.
A general chat model answering the same question, for comparison.
A typed-judgment service returning a calibrated decision rather than text.

definition.zh-CN: 在与人的评审对话中由模型提出、当场附上依据原文的边。与批量判断同属 ai_proposed，同样必须经人工确认才能改为 reviewed。
definition.en: Proposed by a model during a review conversation with a person, with its source text attached. Still machine-proposed: it needs confirming like any other.
Does completing this work autonomously require this capability?
Does this gate stop this work even when the capabilities are met?
What does this event show about this capability, and how strongly?
Which controlled kind is this event?

statement.zh-CN: 一个能力状态的自主阶段，不得超过支撑它的最高证据层级所允许的上限。

method 为 ai_proposed 的关系，status 必须是 candidate，且不得断言 exact 或 source_projection。
概念定义若声明 basis 为来源文本，其正文必须逐字等于该来源原文。
lifecycle 为 deprecated 的概念，必须同时给出 replaced_by 或 obsolescence_reason；被停用的 ID 不得被新概念复用。
每条 blocked_by 边必须指出依据的任务 ID，不能只写理由文字。
受控词表不设 other。判不出来返回 null 并记 unresolved_reason。
任何指向组织的字段必须是组织 ID，不得为自由文本名称。
类型层节点不得携带状态、时间或置信度字段。能力与闸门的状态一律存 PG。
事件身份为 (primary_org_id, kind, subject_key) 三元组；标题只作展示，不参与身份。subject_key 缺失时退回标题 slug 并标记 identity_confidence=low。
一项能力若被判定为超过半数已判断工作节点所需要，就不再能区分工作，因此不得进入职业层结论、不得进入影响力排序；它的边保留、公开，并在页面上带着这个比例一起显示。
statement.en: A capability required by more than half of the judged work nodes no longer distinguishes between kinds of work, so it cannot carry an occupation-level conclusion or enter impact ranking. Its edges are kept and published, shown with the measured share attached.

scope.zh-CN: 目前只作用于能力，不作用于闸门。同样的道理对闸门成立——一个挡住所有工作的闸门也说不出挡住的是哪些工作——但全量闸门扫描跑到一半时，最宽的 gate:physical-presence 约占已判断工作的三成，离 0.5 还有距离，没有一个闸门接近这条线。为一个当前无人触发的情形先建一套机制，比把这个缺口写下来更糟。等到有闸门越过阈值时再实现，并在这里补上理由。

statement.zh-CN: 一条活动证据能支持到的活动层级，不得超过它自己的证据层级所允许的上限。
statement.en: The level a piece of activity evidence can support may not exceed the cap its own evidence tier allows.

statement.zh-CN: 一条任务的层级，取覆盖它的各条活动中最低的那个，不是最高的。任务要整件做完才算做完，任何一环 AI 做不了，这条任务就没做完。
statement.en: A task's level is the LOWEST among the activities that cover it, never the highest. A task is done only when all of it is done, so AI failing at any part means the task is not done.

statement.zh-CN: 已判定、未知、未触及是三种状态，没有一种等于 0。「问过但没有任何方向的证据」和「从没问过」都不是「AI 做不了」。
statement.en: Assessed, unknown and untouched are three states and none of them is zero. Neither "asked and nothing came back" nor "never asked" means "AI cannot do this".

statement.zh-CN: 名单账号的状态只由检查日志推导：身份依据至少为本人简介且平台 ID 已解析，才算身份已确认；未被剔除、任职检查未过期、近期活跃，才启用；任一条件失效即暂停，恢复后自动启用。
独立性按公司、按时间判断：帖子发布时，账号与被谈论机构存在 breaks_independence 的有效关系，或账号本身就是该机构运营的账号，其帖子对该机构只算厂商自证。
一条更新同时满足「有被证据层级压低的声明」和「足够重要」，才去名单里找第三方；重要指热度位于窗口前 20%，或更新类型属于指定类型。 在第 7 天热度定稿后才判断，暂估热度不触发。
每条帖子只采两次：首次发现时一次，发帖后第 7 天一次作为定稿。热度以第 7 天的互动量（点赞 + 转发 + 引用 + 回复）排名，并附相对该账号中位互动量的倍数；不满 7 天的为暂估，只用于展示，不参与定稿排名、不触发验证。缺失为空，不当作 0；热度不进入任何级别计算。
statement.en: Each post is captured twice: when first seen, and at day 7 after posting as the final reading. Attention is ranked by day-7 engagement (likes + reposts + quotes + replies), with its multiple of the account's median alongside. Under 7 days it is provisional: shown, but not ranked as final and never used to trigger verification. Missing is null, never zero; attention never enters any level.

statement.zh-CN: 非技术障碍把环节可记的级别上限定为 L3：必须有人在场、签字或担责的工作，到不了无人交付（L4/L5），但 AI 仍可做到 L1–L3。障碍作为单独标签展示，不藏进级别。
statement.en: A non-technical barrier caps an activity at L3: work that needs a person present, signing or answerable cannot reach delivery without a person (L4/L5), but AI can still do L1-L3 of it. The barrier is shown as its own label, not hidden in the level.

statement.zh-CN: 判官分数低于 1 的证据不构成级别：它说明「有关，但没达到 L1」，只保留作记录，不参与计算。只有这类证据的环节是证据不全，不是 L0。
statement.en: A judge score below 1 is not a level: it says 'related, but short of L1'. Kept on record, not counted. An activity with only such evidence has incomplete evidence, not L0.

statement.zh-CN: 名单帖子的证据层级只由帖子性质和作者独立性决定：作者与被谈论机构不独立时不产生证据；亲手测试、独立评测、本机构生产使用算第三方验证（T1）；专家评估算多方印证（T2）；观点、转述、无关不产生证据。账号角色不参与。
statement.en: A panel post's tier comes from the post and its author's independence only: no evidence when the author is tied to the company; hands-on test, independent evaluation or own production use is T1; expert assessment is T2; opinion, relay and unrelated give none. The account's role plays no part.

statement.zh-CN: 账号自己的资料可以确立身份：个人账号的显示名与人物姓名一致，且简介提到该人物已记录的任职机构，视为本人简介依据（official_bio）；机构账号的显示名与机构名一致即可。仅名字一致不足以确认个人身份，冒名账号常用同名。
statement.en: An account's own profile can establish identity: for a person, the display name matches and the bio names an affiliation already on record; for an organisation, the display name matches. A matching name alone never confirms a person - impersonators use the same name.

statement.zh-CN: 帖子性质决定它最多能证明到哪一级：L4 要求「已在真实业务中运行」，只有本机构生产使用能证明；亲手测试、独立评测、专家评估再强也只能证明到 L3。
statement.en: What a post is limits how far it can show: L4 requires running in real business, which only own production use can show; a hands-on test, an independent evaluation or an expert assessment shows L3 at most.

statement.zh-CN: 帖子沿回复、引用、转发链归属到事件：链上游是事件原帖或已归属的帖子，就归属同一事件，并记录深度。没有上游关系的帖子，在事件发生后 7 天内提到产品全部关键词，记为提及。一条帖子可以归属多个事件（例如一条帖子同时宣布两个模型）。 产品标识若是其他产品标识的前缀（如 gemini 之于 gemini 3 8 flash），属于品牌名而非具体产品，不参与提及匹配。一条提及只归属一个事件：取产品名最具体者，再取帖子之前最近发生者。
statement.en: A post links to an event through reply, quote and repost chains whose upstream is the event's source post or an already linked post, with its depth. A post with no upstream that names every word of the product within 7 days of the event is a mention. A post may link to several events.
A product, app, agent, feature, platform or service never enters the model registry, even when it runs on a model or shares its brand.
statement.zh-CN: 产品、应用、智能体、功能、平台、服务不进模型表，即使它跑在模型上或与模型同名。

statement.en: A model is confirmed, and dated, only by its maker's own release update that names it as subject. A catalog listing or another company's mention confirms nothing.
statement.zh-CN: 模型只由厂商自己、以它为主体的发布帖确认并取得发布时间。目录收录或别家公司的提及都不构成确认。

statement.en: A model's owner is the maker named in the catalog's canonical id or stated in the post, never the provider that lists it.
statement.zh-CN: 模型的归属方是目录规范标识里的出品方或帖子写明的出品方，不是上架它的供应商。

statement.en: A mention is looked up in the alias table, which holds the catalog's names, before a new candidate is opened. The judge never picks a registry row.
statement.zh-CN: 提及先查别名表（含目录的名字），查不到才开新候选。判官不直接选模型行。

statement.en: A catalog attribute is taken from the maker's own listing; without one, only when every listing agrees. Otherwise it stays null.
statement.zh-CN: 目录属性取厂商自己的条目；没有时，只有所有条目一致才取。否则留空。

statement.en: A class, property, relation or vocabulary term may say since (the version it first exists in) and until (the last version it is written in). An update is read under the version it was extracted under: a later property is empty on an earlier update and means not recorded; a retired one keeps its old values and is no longer written. Nothing is re-extracted by default; when a batch is re-extracted on purpose, an update with the same identity is upgraded in place and its earlier content stays in the extraction archive of the time.
statement.zh-CN: 类、属性、关系、词表项可以写 since（从哪一版开始有）和 until（到哪一版为止还在写）。一条更新按它被提取时的版本解读：后来新增的属性在更早的更新上为空，含义是当时没有记录；失效的属性保留旧值，不再写入。默认不重抽；主动重抽某一批时，身份相同的更新在原行上升级，升级前的内容保留在当时的提取归档里。

statement.en: An update is read only from the original post: an account announcing its own thing, or the author's own first-hand use, test or measurement. A post that passes on what someone else did never makes an update. When the thing it passes on is a known update, the post is attached to it as one more account saying so; otherwise it is dropped. Accounts whose panel role is relay never make an update. Someone outside a registered company repeating that company's own claim about its product, and someone inside it doing the same, are both relaying.
statement.zh-CN: 更新只从原帖解析：账号发布它自己的东西，或作者自己第一手的使用、测试或测量。转述别人做了什么的帖子不产生更新。它转述的是一条已知更新时，挂靠到那条更新上，作为又一个这么说的账号；否则丢弃。名单角色为转述的账号不产生更新。注册表内公司之外的人复述该公司对自家产品的说法，以及该公司内部的人这样做，都是转述。

statement.en: The extractor gives every candidate post one outcome: a new update, attached to one known update, or dropped with a reason. A post attaches when it is about that update - repeating it, adding to it, or reporting a use or test of it. Attaching records that the account said so; it does not judge whether the account is right. Known updates are those of the last 30 days, without event announcements. A fact is stored only when its quote is found in the post text. The actor of a new update is the account that posted it.
statement.zh-CN: 提取器给每条候选帖子一个去向：产生新更新、挂靠到一条已知更新、或带原因丢弃。帖子在说某条更新时挂靠：复述它、补充它，或报告对它的使用或测试。挂靠只记录这个账号这么说了，不评判说得对不对。已知更新取近 30 天内的，不含活动公告。事实的引用能在帖子正文里找到才入库。新更新的行动者就是发帖账号。

statement.en: A search reaches accounts the panel does not have. When a post found that way makes an update, its author is recorded as a candidate account - owner unknown, role unclassified, identity grade found_by_search - so the update has an actor. A candidate is never collected by timeline, never enabled without the panel's own identity checks, and its updates stay out of routing, progress and the published list of voices.
statement.zh-CN: 搜索能触及名单之外的账号。这样找到的帖子产生更新时，作者登记为候选账号（归属未知、角色未分类、身份依据为搜索发现），使这条更新有行动者。候选账号不按时间线采集；未经名单自身的身份检查不会启用；它的更新不进入路由、进度和公开的声音名单。

statement.en: A topic names one job or one kind of business, asks one short question a reader answers by picking an option, and has two to four options that exclude each other. Each option is one short plain statement of how things stand - something a measured result, a deployment or a failure could show to be so or not so - not a sentence that concedes one thing and concludes another. A field, a tool, a habit or a hiring practice is not an object.
statement.zh-CN: 话题指向一个职业或一类生意，问一个读者选一个答案就能回答的短问题，带两到四个互斥的选项。每个选项是对现状的一句简短直白的陈述——测得的结果、一次部署或一次失败能表明它成立或不成立——而不是先让步再下结论的复合句。一个领域、一种工具、一种习惯或一种招聘做法不是对象。

statement.en: The same object and the same kind of question are one topic. A claim is placed under an open topic whenever it honestly answers that question, and opens a new topic only when none does. Whether it does is a judgment; a similarity score only shortlists what the judge reads.
statement.zh-CN: 同一个对象、同一类问题只有一个话题。一条主张只要确实在回答某个已开话题的问题就归到它下面，没有这样的话题才提出新话题。是否在回答由判断决定；相似度只用来挑出给判断者看的候选。

statement.en: Every claim read from a post gets one outcome: placed under an answer of an open topic, opening a new topic, or left out with a reason. Placing records that the account said so; it does not judge whether the account is right. The quoted words are stored only when they are found in the post.
statement.zh-CN: 从帖子读出的每条主张有一个去向：归到某个已开话题的一个选项下、提出新话题、或带原因放弃。归入只记录这个账号这么说了，不评判说得对不对。引用的原文能在帖子里找到才保存。

statement.en: A topic never states which answer is right, and no outcome is declared for it. The number of accounts under an answer says who argued it in the posts collected, not how many people think so. Reader votes are shown as reader votes, apart from the evidence. The project gives no replacement percentage.
statement.zh-CN: 话题不说明哪个答案是对的，也不为它判定结果。一个选项下的账号数说明在采集到的帖子里谁这么主张，不是多少人这么认为。读者投票作为读者投票单独显示，与证据分开。项目自己不给出替代百分比。

statement.en: Claims, updates and votes under a topic are counted by calendar quarter (UTC). A past quarter's reading is kept as it was, so a topic shows how it moved from one quarter to the next. A quarter ending decides nothing.
statement.zh-CN: 话题下的主张、更新和投票按自然季度（UTC）计数。过去季度的读数原样保留，因此话题能显示一个季度到下一个季度的变化。季度结束不判定任何结果。

statement.en: Rewording a question, adding an answer or merging two topics never changes an id. A merged topic keeps its id and points at the one it stands under; an answer somebody argued or voted for is retired, not deleted.
statement.zh-CN: 修订问题的措辞、增加选项或合并两个话题都不改变编号。被并入的话题保留编号并指向它所归属的那个；有人主张过或投过票的选项只停用，不删除。

statement.en: A market measurement hangs on a market or an occupation, never on one company's product, and is never routed to work: it says how much AI is used, paid for or how employment moved, not how far a piece of work can be done. No activity level, gate or progress value reads it.
statement.zh-CN: 市场测量挂在一个市场或一个职业上，不挂在某家公司的产品上，也不对应到工作：它说明 AI 被用了多少、付了多少费、就业如何变化，不说明某项工作能做到什么程度。任何工作等级、闸门或进度值都不读它。

statement.en: Which updates stand under a topic is derived, not judged: a market measurement of the entry the topic is about, or an update that is evidence for a piece of work in the market the topic is about. An update is listed under a topic; it is not placed under one of its answers.
statement.zh-CN: 哪些更新列在一个话题下面是推导出来的，不另作判断：对话题所关于的条目所做的市场测量，或是话题所关于的市场里某项工作的证据的更新。更新列在话题下面，不归到它的某个选项下。

statement.en: An update stands under a topic only through one of its answers. A local embedding shortlists the few topics an update could be about - the score decides nothing - and a judge is then asked, for each answer of those topics, whether the update supports it and whether it contradicts it. Being in the same market is not enough. What the judge says is a proposal and stays a candidate; it records which way an update weighs on an answer, and no answer is declared right.
statement.zh-CN: 更新只通过话题的某个答案列到话题下。本机向量先挑出这条更新可能相关的少数几个话题（相似度不做决定），再由判官对这些话题的每个答案分别判断：这条更新是否支持它、是否反驳它。处于同一个市场不够。判官的结论是提议，保持候选；它记录的是更新偏向某个答案的哪一边，不判定哪个答案是对的。
